title: 第1188章 庆功宴中第1187章 庆功宴上
content_zh:
仙界人设宴还是那样，把食物集中到一个地方，想吃什么自己去拿。这点陆长风觉得挺好，既不浪费，也能避免主人上了一样自以为很好的东西，客人却觉得很难吃的尴尬。
“来，兄弟，咱俩走一个！”
“……”
林卫的热情让陆长风本能地犹豫了一下。无他，上次林卫约他喝酒，给他喝出心理阴影了，他现在下意识觉得对方敬自己准没好事。但是，他觉得林卫应该不会在这个时候整他，于是便放下戒备，跟对方喝几杯。
“林哥，这肉……”
“怎么了？”
见陆长风神色古怪，林卫本能地警惕起来。
“太好吃了，哈哈……”
“你小子，吓我一跳！”
林卫又好气又好笑，给了陆长风一拳，后者连连赔罪。
其实陆长风没说实话，这肉不对，但并非被下药，而是烤熟的，用的柴火，还加了不少香料。虽然经过后续处理，一般人可能认不出来，可陆长风厨艺造诣不浅，一吃就吃出来了。
“兄弟，有几个熟人叫我，我去去就来，你自便哈！”
“好的，林哥公务繁忙，不用管小弟！”
酒宴进行没多久，林卫就被几个人叫走了。他是天帝城本地人，跟着少主在外数年，回到家自有一帮老朋友来找他叙旧。
这个热闹，陆长风就不凑了，正好他也不喜欢有人看着他吃东西。林卫一走，他完全自由，不用管什么礼节不礼节的，想吃什么自己拿就好了。
流云雪鳞羹，取雪山天池灵鲤背脊最嫩的雪鳞，佐天庭瑶池晨露慢炖而成，羹汤通透如流云，不见半点腥气，入口温润顺滑，转瞬化开，一缕清灵仙气直窜四肢百骸，涤荡周身浊气，食之通体舒泰，疲乏尽消。
朱华灵雀炙，选用吸纳百年日精月华的灵雀，以火慢烤，外皮微焦鎏金，内里肉质细嫩多汁，入口鲜香醇厚，食后丹田温热，灵气绵绵不绝。
赤焰兽炙，取自上古异种赤焰灵兽的肋间嫩肉……
不得不说，这有烟火气息，再用权利熏烤出来的美食，实在太好吃了。他本来就能吃，这种自助的宴会简直是为他量身打造的，就像老鼠掉进米缸里，开心，实在太开心了。既然如此，那还等什么！
……

主席台上，仙乐悠悠流淌，酒香馥郁，宴席氛围松弛和睦，满堂皆是君臣欢叙的升平景象。天帝父子则屏去周遭细碎声响，开启了闲话家常。
“神界广袤苍茫，风土格局与我仙界截然不同，你这数年在外漂泊，可还适应那边的起居与修行氛围？”
天帝语气温和，满是关切之意。只是此番问话落下，少主却并未如往日般从容畅谈，反而在眉宇间藏着一丝沉郁，应答也略显平淡敷衍：“回父帝，儿臣尚可适应，皆能自持。”
content_en:
People in the immortal world still hold banquets in the same way. They gather the food in one place and get what they want to eat. Lu Changfeng thinks this is very good. It is not wasteful, and it can avoid the embarrassment of having something that the host thinks is good but the guests find it tastes terrible.
"Come on, brother, let's go one by one!"
"..."
Lin Wei's enthusiasm made Lu Changfeng hesitate instinctively. Without him, Lin Wei asked him for a drink last time, which had a psychological impact on him. Now he subconsciously felt that the other party's respect for him was not good. However, he felt that Lin Wei would not punish him at this time, so he put down his guard and had a few drinks with him.
"Brother Lin, this meat..."
"What's wrong?"
Seeing Lu Changfeng's strange expression, Lin Wei instinctively became vigilant.
"It's so delicious, haha..."
"You kid, you scared me!"
Lin Wei was angry and funny, so he punched Lu Changfeng, who apologized repeatedly.
In fact, Lu Changfeng didn't tell the truth. The meat was wrong, but it was not drugged, but roasted using firewood and adding a lot of spices. Although most people may not be able to recognize it after subsequent processing, Lu Changfeng's culinary skills are quite impressive, and it's obvious as soon as he eats it.
"Brother, a few acquaintances call me. I'll come as soon as I go. You can do whatever you want!"
"Okay, Brother Lin is busy with official duties, so don't worry about me!"
Not long after the banquet, Lin Wei was called away by several people. He is a native of Tiandi City. He has been away with the young master for several years. When he returned home, a group of old friends came to him to catch up with him.
Lu Changfeng didn't want to join in the fun, because he didn't like people watching him eat. As soon as Lin Wei left, he was completely free. He didn't have to worry about etiquette or etiquette. He could just take what he wanted to eat.
Liuyun Snow Scale Soup is made from the tenderest snow scales from the back of the spirit carp in the Snow Mountain Tianchi and slowly simmered with the morning dew of the Tianting Yaochi. The soup is as transparent as flowing clouds without any fishy smell. The entrance is warm and smooth, and it melts in an instant. A wisp of clear spiritual energy flows straight through the limbs and bones, cleansing the turbid air all over the body. After eating, the whole body is soothed and fatigue is gone.
Zhu Hualing Bird Roast uses the spirit bird that has absorbed the essence of the sun and the moon for hundreds of years, and roasts it slowly with fire. The outer skin is slightly burnt and gilded, and the meat is tender and juicy on the inside.
The red flame beast roast is taken from the tender meat from the ribs of the ancient exotic red flame spirit beast...
I have to say, this has the smell of fireworks, and the delicacies cooked with power are so delicious. He could have eaten it. This kind of buffet banquet was tailor-made for him. He was like a mouse falling into a rice vat. He was so happy. He was so happy. In that case, what are you waiting for!
…
On the rostrum, fairy music flowed leisurely, the wine was fragrant, the atmosphere of the banquet was relaxed and harmonious, and the whole hall was filled with the scene of peace and tranquility among the monarchs and ministers. The Heavenly Emperor and his son ignored the surrounding noises and started chatting.
"The divine world is vast and vast, and its customs and patterns are completely different from those of our fairy world. You have been wandering outside for the past few years, but have you still adapted to the living and cultivation atmosphere there?"
The Emperor's tone was gentle and full of concern. However, when the question came to an end, the young master did not speak as calmly as before. Instead, there was a trace of depression hidden in his brows, and his response was a little bland and perfunctory: "Back to my father, I can still adapt to my situation and can control myself."
